evidence: Written floor defenses are substantive: task/tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 requires a fresh authored marker to execute in both preview and console, excluding blank/static/keyword-only pages and action-refusing shells. gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29 requires an actual new UI write and exact independent-clean-context server readback, excluding seed copies and localStorage-only mock libraries. Each scored prompt rechecks usable surfaces/server data and zeros its dimension on gate failure (functional:5; polish:13-22; visual:33-41). Functional prompt:25,100 requires positive controls, so refusing every action cannot earn negative-result credit. scoring.toml:1-11 and tools/score.py:40-48 apply zero-weight gates and strict functional >0.05; test.sh:212-227 stops before scored after a failed gate. Verified all 43 arithmetic-control artifacts against the current index; frozen scorer/scoring/test.sh hashes match their recorded bindings and frozen template. Raw outputs give 0 for either failed gate, functional=0, and functional=0.05 even with perfect presentation; functional=0.06 gives 0.436. These are supplied-dimension arithmetic only: probe.py:26-30 writes the input scores, observations.json:3-8 explicitly records no configured judge. Thus the 0.436 boundary is not a measured mock-app score. Current raw-evidence-index.json:455-460 explicitly lists empirical configured floor/ranking as unmeasured; REVIEW_POLICY.md:31 requires hash-bound runtime discrimination evidence. No configured blank/static/mock/seed-copy/stuffing/refusal rewards are available to establish the empirical claim, so this row cannot be cleared.
counterexample: Reasoned weak-app challenge, not a demonstrated failure: a polished workspace with real snippet execution but a static seed library or localStorage-only Save could look convincing and earn presentation credit; the clean-context gate explicitly rejects it. A marker-echo facade with server Save is a remaining empirical adversarial case, not proven to pass. Conforming alternative considered: an initially empty library, server-rendered record readback and CDN app assets are expressly accepted (constraints:27-29; scored prompts; instruction.md final paragraph), so these should not be treated as floor cases.
suggested_fix: After provider runs are authorized, record hash-bound configured-judge rewards and raw observations for representative blank, static/mock, seed-copy, keyword-stuffed and always-refusing submissions, including a convincing facade, plus a conforming alternative; retain the evidence gap until then and do not alter shared reward policy to manufacture a floor.
